properties.description: End-to-end ETL pipeline for UPS Finance Billing Transactions. Reads raw billing CSV, transforms and aggregates using data flow, and sinks the report to output CSV. Integration Runtime must be configured manually.

activities.name: ValidateSourceFileExists
activities.description: Check that the source billing_transactions.csv file exists before processing

activities.name: CheckFileExists
activities.description: Branch on whether the source file actually exists

ifFalseActivities.name: LogFileMissing
ifFalseActivities.description: Fail the pipeline with a clear message if source file does not exist

message.value: @concat('Source file billing_transactions.csv was not found in container ups-finance-source/billing/raw. Pipeline run ID: ', pipeline().RunId)

ifTrueActivities.name: RunBillingTransformDataFlow
ifTrueActivities.description: Execute the billing transactions mapping data flow for transformation and aggregation

activities.name: LogPipelineSuccess
activities.description: Set a success variable with run metadata after successful data flow execution

properties.description: Master orchestration pipeline for UPS Finance & Billing. Executes both the Billing Transactions ETL and Invoice Summary ETL pipelines in parallel, then logs overall completion status.

activities.name: RunBillingETL
activities.description: Invoke the Billing Transactions ETL child pipeline

activities.name: RunInvoiceETL
activities.description: Invoke the Invoice Summary ETL child pipeline (runs in parallel with Billing ETL)

activities.name: CheckBothPipelinesSucceeded
activities.description: Evaluate success of both child pipelines

value.value: @concat('PARTIAL_FAILURE | BillingETL: ', activity('RunBillingETL').Status, ' | InvoiceETL: ', activity('RunInvoiceETL').Status, ' | RunId: ', pipeline().RunId)

activities.name: ValidateInvoiceFileExists

activities.name: CheckInvoiceFileExists

ifFalseActivities.name: LogInvoiceFileMissing

message.value: @concat('Source file invoice_summary.csv was not found. Pipeline run ID: ', pipeline().RunId)

ifTrueActivities.name: RunInvoiceTransformDataFlow
ifTrueActivities.description: Execute the invoice summary mapping data flow

properties.description: Sink dataset for transformed and aggregated UPS Billing Report output CSV
Source dataset for UPS Billing Transactions CSV file stored in Azure Blob Storage
Source dataset for UPS Customer Accounts CSV file
Sink dataset for per-customer aggregated billing summary output CSV
Source dataset for UPS Invoice Summary CSV file
Linked Service for sink Azure Blob Storage to store transformed UPS Finance & Billing CSV outputs
Linked Service for source Azure Blob Storage containing UPS Finance & Billing CSV files
Daily scheduled trigger for UPS Finance Master Pipeline. Runs every day at 2:00 AM UTC to process the previous day's billing and invoice data.
Data flow to transform, cleanse, and aggregate UPS billing transactions. Joins billing data with customer accounts, applies surcharge calculations, and aggregates totals by customer and service type.

sources.name: SourceCustomerAccounts
sources.description: Read customer accounts CSV for join

sinks.name: SinkBillingReport
sinks.description: Write aggregated billing report to output CSV

transformations.name: FilterValidTransactions
transformations.description: Remove records with null TransactionID or zero TotalCharge

transformations.name: CastDataTypes
transformations.description: Cast string columns to proper numeric and date types

transformations.name: DeriveCalculatedColumns
transformations.description: Derive effective tax rate, total surcharges, and net billing amount

transformations.name: JoinCustomerData
transformations.description: Left join billing transactions with customer accounts on CustomerID

transformations.name: AggregateByCustomerAndService
transformations.description: Aggregate totals grouped by CustomerID, CompanyName, and ServiceType

transformations.name: SortByTotalChargeDesc
transformations.description: Sort final output by TotalCharge descending

typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		TransactionID as string,
		CustomerID as string,
		ShipmentID as string,
		BillingDate as string,
		ServiceType as string,
		WeightLbs as string,
		Zone as string,
		BaseCharge as string,
		FuelSurcharge as string,
		ResidentialFee as string,
		DeclaredValue as string,
		TotalCharge as string,
		Currency as string,
		PaymentStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> SourceBillingTransactions
source(output(
		CustomerID as string,
		AccountNumber as string,
		CompanyName as string,
		ContactName as string,
		Email as string,
		Phone as string,
		BillingAddress as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		ZipCode as string,
		Country as string,
		AccountType as string,
		CreditLimit as string,
		AccountStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> SourceCustomerAccounts
SourceBillingTransactions filter(!isNull(TransactionID) && toDouble(TotalCharge) > 0) ~> FilterValidTransactions
FilterValidTransactions derive(BillingDate = toDate(BillingDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		WeightLbs = toDouble(WeightLbs),
		BaseCharge = toDouble(BaseCharge),
		FuelSurcharge = toDouble(FuelSurcharge),
		ResidentialFee = toDouble(ResidentialFee),
		DeclaredValue = toDouble(DeclaredValue),
		TotalCharge = toDouble(TotalCharge)) ~> CastDataTypes
CastDataTypes derive(TotalSurcharges = FuelSurcharge + ResidentialFee,
		NetBillingAmount = TotalCharge - (FuelSurcharge + ResidentialFee),
		ProcessedTimestamp = currentTimestamp(),
		BillingMonth = month(BillingDate),
		BillingYear = year(BillingDate)) ~> DeriveCalculatedColumns
DeriveCalculatedColumns, SourceCustomerAccounts join(SourceBillingTransactions@CustomerID == SourceCustomerAccounts@CustomerID,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto',
	matchCondition: 'none')~> JoinCustomerData
JoinCustomerData aggregate(groupBy(SourceBillingTransactions@CustomerID,
		CompanyName,
		AccountType,
		ServiceType,
		BillingMonth,
		BillingYear,
		Currency),
	TotalTransactions = count(TransactionID),
		TotalWeightLbs = sum(WeightLbs),
		TotalBaseCharge = round(sum(BaseCharge), 2),
		TotalFuelSurcharge = round(sum(FuelSurcharge), 2),
		TotalResidentialFee = round(sum(ResidentialFee), 2),
		TotalSurcharges = round(sum(TotalSurcharges), 2),
		TotalNetBilling = round(sum(NetBillingAmount), 2),
		GrandTotalCharge = round(sum(TotalCharge), 2),
		AvgChargePerShipment = round(avg(TotalCharge), 2)) ~> AggregateByCustomerAndService
AggregateByCustomerAndService sort(desc(GrandTotalCharge, true)) ~> SortByTotalChargeDesc
SortByTotalChargeDesc sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	truncate: true,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SinkBillingReport

properties.description: Data flow to process and enrich UPS invoice summary data. Joins invoices with customer accounts, classifies invoices by aging bucket, and outputs customer-level billing summaries.

sinks.name: SinkCustomerBillingSummary
sinks.description: Write customer billing summary output CSV

transformations.name: CastInvoiceTypes
transformations.description: Cast monetary and date columns to proper types

transformations.name: DeriveAgingAndFlags
transformations.description: Derive DaysOutstanding, AgingBucket, and IsOverdue flag

transformations.name: JoinCustomerInfo
transformations.description: Inner join invoices with customer accounts on CustomerID

transformations.name: SelectFinalColumns
transformations.description: Select and rename final output columns

typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		InvoiceID as string,
		CustomerID as string,
		InvoiceDate as string,
		DueDate as string,
		BillingPeriodStart as string,
		BillingPeriodEnd as string,
		TotalShipments as string,
		TotalWeight as string,
		SubTotal as string,
		TaxAmount as string,
		DiscountAmount as string,
		InvoiceTotal as string,
		Currency as string,
		InvoiceStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> SourceInvoiceSummary
source(output(
		CustomerID as string,
		AccountNumber as string,
		CompanyName as string,
		ContactName as string,
		Email as string,
		Phone as string,
		BillingAddress as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		ZipCode as string,
		Country as string,
		AccountType as string,
		CreditLimit as string,
		AccountStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> SourceCustomerAccounts
SourceInvoiceSummary filter(InvoiceStatus == 'PENDING' || InvoiceStatus == 'OVERDUE') ~> FilterActiveInvoices
FilterActiveInvoices derive(InvoiceDate = toDate(InvoiceDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		DueDate = toDate(DueDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		BillingPeriodStart = toDate(BillingPeriodStart, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		BillingPeriodEnd = toDate(BillingPeriodEnd, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		TotalShipments = toInteger(TotalShipments),
		TotalWeight = toDouble(TotalWeight),
		SubTotal = toDouble(SubTotal),
		TaxAmount = toDouble(TaxAmount),
		DiscountAmount = toDouble(DiscountAmount),
		InvoiceTotal = toDouble(InvoiceTotal)) ~> CastInvoiceTypes
CastInvoiceTypes derive(DaysOutstanding = toInteger(currentDate() - toDate(toString(DueDate), 'yyyy-MM-dd')),
		EffectiveInvoiceAmount = InvoiceTotal - DiscountAmount) ~> DeriveAgingAndFlags
derivedColumn1, SourceCustomerAccounts join(SourceInvoiceSummary@CustomerID == SourceCustomerAccounts@CustomerID,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto',
	matchCondition: 'none')~> JoinCustomerInfo
JoinCustomerInfo aggregate(groupBy(SourceInvoiceSummary@CustomerID,
		CompanyName,
		AccountNumber,
		ContactName,
		Email,
		City,
		State,
		Country,
		AccountType,
		AccountStatus,
		Currency),
	TotalInvoices = count(InvoiceID),
		TotalShipments = sum(TotalShipments),
		TotalSubAmount = round(sum(SubTotal), 2),
		TotalTaxAmount = round(sum(TaxAmount), 2),
		TotalDiscounts = round(sum(DiscountAmount), 2),
		OverdueInvoiceCount = countIf(IsOverdue),
		TotalAmountDue = round(sum(EffectiveInvoiceAmount), 2),
		OldestDaysOutstanding = max(DaysOutstanding),
		CurrentBucket = countIf(AgingBucket == 'Current'),
		Bucket_1_30 = countIf(AgingBucket == '1-30 Days'),
		Bucket_31_60 = countIf(AgingBucket == '31-60 Days'),
		Bucket_61_90 = countIf(AgingBucket == '61-90 Days'),
		Bucket_90Plus = countIf(AgingBucket == '90+ Days')) ~> AggregateCustomerSummary
AggregateCustomerSummary select(mapColumn(
		CustomerID,
		AccountNumber,
		CompanyName,
		ContactName,
		Email,
		City,
		State,
		Country,
		AccountType,
		AccountStatus,
		Currency,
		TotalInvoices,
		TotalShipments,
		TotalSubAmount,
		TotalTaxAmount,
		TotalDiscounts,
		TotalAmountDue,
		OldestDaysOutstanding,
		OverdueInvoiceCount,
		CurrentBucket,
		Bucket_1_30,
		Bucket_31_60,
		Bucket_61_90,
		Bucket_90Plus
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectFinalColumns
DeriveAgingAndFlags derive(AgingBucket = iif(DaysOutstanding <= 0, 'Current',                   iif(DaysOutstanding <= 30, '1-30 Days',                   iif(DaysOutstanding <= 60, '31-60 Days',                   iif(DaysOutstanding <= 90, '61-90 Days', '90+ Days')))),
		IsOverdue = DaysOutstanding > 0) ~> derivedColumn1
SelectFinalColumns sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	truncate: true,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SinkCustomerBillingSummary
